summary.text: Johnny Salling is the Republican state senator for Maryland District 6, in office since January 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Justin Holliday.

paragraphs.text: Johnny Ray Salling took office in the Maryland State Senate on January 14, 2015.

In the 2025-2026 term he serves on the Budget & Taxation Committee, along with the Legislative Policy, Chesapeake and Atlantic Coastal Bays Critical Area, Gaming Oversight and Spending Affordability committees.
